title: What the player owns, first slice: Isao prints a scoreboard by the landing pad (YOU against his sentries and the sky, in numbers and quarter-circle base-16 glyphs) with the pilot's rank on a flag beside it; and the Units bench's ANIMATION is the sentry lab's range for every unit
context: Owner, 2026-10-02, answering the ledger's R7/R9 rows: "we could offer playful tank customization. A flag showing the Rank (linked with stronger tank secondary plasma throwers), displayed in the base. A trophy counter of how many enemies have been killed. Diegetic panel in the base, perhaps using the suji-galore Base16 quarter-Circle logic, or just a pure scoreboard.... Isao Printing a literal scoreboard in the base, like Gimli and Legolas joking about who has the more kills". Same message, the Units viewer: the arrows still jumped (the FIRE row), the orbital lasers had no fire, every sentry fired in one direction from the base, and the sentry lab's platform with waves of enemies was wanted for all units, the tank ramming.
outcome: THE BOARD: a programme step `board` (sector 1, idle; the first colony step) prints a 8x6 slab between the landing pad and HUGIN; the host raises src/fx/scoreboard.js on it from the step's print bed: a plaque (YOU = tank + ram kills, ISAO = the sentries', SKY = gunship + strike + SOL; each as a number and as sūji-galore's Quarter-Circle B16 glyph, src/domain/score-glyphs.js: four quarter arcs per hex digit, units place outermost, zero a dot) and a flag in the rank tier's colour carrying the rank badge (src/ranks.js badgeSVG) and label; the rank ladder already rearms the secondary at ranks 1/5/10/15 (src/beamranks.js), which is the owner's link. Isao: build_board and, once, board_lead when the player passes his sentries. THE BENCH RANGE: src/labs/bench-range.js (the sentry lab's disc, grid, rings and waves on src/sentry.js's rules) under every unit in ANIMATION; a sentry's head and barrel slew onto the nearest walker at SENTRY_TUNE rates and towerShot now fires along a direction at a point (the old pattern fired every family along world +Z); the hull drives and rams; the gunship circles and rakes; SOL lays src/fx/orbital-laser.js's column and walks it; kills are the range's. The sounds row keeps its height so the arrows never move. NOT DONE: the livery (the A6 customization package: lod1 D0 with paint roles, four presets, a runtime needing DecalGeometry and mergeGeometries, a hull-asset swap the owner shelved on 2026-09-14): proposed, with its cost, for the owner's call.
alternatives: A HUD counter: the owner asked for a diegetic panel in the base
Isao printing the board as a GLB structure: there is no such asset; a canvas plaque on the step's slab is one module and no pin
Tying the flag to the works or the colony: the rank is the player's own, the only thing on the base that is
